finalText:
It's building clean now — exit 0.

Two real bugs were hiding in that wall of deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it hands to your code:

- `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined` — the old config loader used to send `false` for an unset flag, the new one sends nothing. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled instead of erroring.

The rest (Buffer, punycode, module.parent deprecations, etc.) is just noise from the bump and still prints as warnings, but it's not breaking anything — build exits 0 with 8 warnings.
